# deep_merge v1.0.2 - Table of Contents

> Deep (recursive) merging for maps, keyword lists and whatever else
you may want via implementing a simple protocol.

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://deep-merge.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [DeepMerge](https://deep-merge.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [DeepMerge](https://deep-merge.hexdocs.pm/DeepMerge.md): Provides functionality for deeply/recursively merging structures (normally for
`Map` and `Keyword`).
- [DeepMerge.Resolver](https://deep-merge.hexdocs.pm/DeepMerge.Resolver.md): Protocol defining how conflicts during deep_merge should be resolved.
